sources.currentSkillSection: 武将技能介绍 官网首页 游戏资讯 赛事广场 视听中心 游戏资料 游戏攻略 武将介绍 模式介绍 内容中心 常见问题 关注我们 桃园社区 武将详情 管亥 管亥 管亥 进攻 防御 多刀 武将生平： 青州黄巾首领。曾率兵围困孔融于都昌，期间杀死郑玄之子郑益。太史慈前往救援孔融，后求援刘备。刘备赶到后，管亥等众退散。小说《三国演义》中，管亥在此时被关羽所杀。 武将特点： 根据局势适时关注拼点的输赢，可以创造更大的收益。 武将技能： 卸尾 诱阙 你可以将两张手牌置于武将牌上，称为“饵”，视为使用一张【杀】或【闪】。 出牌阶段，你可以用点数最小的“饵”拼点。没赢的角色弃置点数大于其拼点牌的所有手牌，视为对赢的角色使用一张【杀】。此【杀】造成伤害后，你摸两张牌，若你没有黑桃的“饵”，此技能此阶段失效。

guides.title: 【武将攻略】围师遗阙的“黄巾军渠帅”—管亥
guides.classification: same-product author guide, not official FAQ
supportedParaphrases: Only two genuine Hand cards pay Xiewei; use-only Slash/Dodge, not Duel/AOE pure played.
Youque still requires nonempty Hand; bait minimum rank selected, equal minima permit choosing an entity.
Equal pindian has no discard or virtual Slash.
Only positive actual damage from the resulting Slash leads to Draw2, then check for any remaining Spade bait and disable the current actual Play.
An asserted hidden 10-use cap is not official text and conflicts with current client timeLimitRound=12 metadata; do not silently encode guide ten as a proven rule.

guides.classification: same-product guide repost; not independent FAQ

supportedGuideReadings.reading: Xiewei pays exactly two Hand cards as one visible bait deposit; it produces a genuine Use of Slash or Dodge and cannot answer Duel or AOE as a merely played card. Hujia is admitted only for its true Dodge-use supply direction.
Youque retains the normal source-Hand>0 and opponent-Hand>0 Pindian requirements; a public bait is its original source entity, never a temporary Hand card.
Choose among actual minimum printed-rank bait entities; ties among equal minimum bait allow an entity choice. Native Pindian rank modifiers still determine the winner.
supportedGuideReadings.classification: published minimum-bait rule + native Pindian composition

supportedGuideReadings.reading: A tie has no winning role, therefore no loser discard or follow-up Slash.
supportedGuideReadings.classification: same-product-guide; also follows the requirement for a winning target

supportedGuideReadings.reading: Each actual positive damage caused by the induced Slash first draws two, finishes that real draw and all its children, then checks the current bait for Spade. Dodge/prevention causing no damage does not draw or disable.

implementationInferences.decision: The two deposited Hand entities are costs only. The logical Slash/Dodge is suit None, rank0, color null; cost provenance is preserved on the native action, while those entities never become Processing materials or acquire Used/ResponseFinished cleanup or claim rights.
implementationInferences.authority: Current client virtual-use menu and ordinary native virtual-output contract; not a dedicated official FAQ.

implementationInferences.decision: Normal true Slash target count, next-use adjustment and target-finalization abilities remain applicable. The initial two-Hand cost prevents the ordinary Fangtian last-single-Hand prerequisite. Color-dependent additional-target rules use the output color None, not the bait colors.
implementationInferences.authority: Combination inference; no special FAQ excludes ordinary target-count policies.

implementationInferences.decision: The real Pindian loser is the native use actor and the winner its original target. The required follow-up uses the existing forced-Slash native contract: countsTowardLimit false and no range check, while genuine directed/card/beneficiary prohibitions still apply.
implementationInferences.authority: Native forced-use composition inference, not an exclusive Guan Hai FAQ.

implementationInferences.decision: Once the two-Hand deposit or the native Pindian is issued, source loss does not refund or repeat it. A dead issuer does not receive a fresh draw; an already accepted native use and its paid children finish using their exact receipts. A dead loser/winner or truly prohibited target skips the unavailable follow-up.

Reward eligibility is tied to each actual AfterDamageApplied event of the exact issued Slash. Repeated effects/chain damage use their native damage events; missed or prevented attempts do not create reward invoices.
implementationInferences.authority: Published damage-after wording with native per-damage semantics; no multi-damage special FAQ found.

implementationInferences.decision: The disabled state is stamped to the original actual Play token, including an inserted actual Play. A later actual Play starts a new qualification; restoration of the same Play retains its disabled state.
implementationInferences.authority: Published 此阶段 with actual native phase interpretation.

unadoptedConflictingLimits.guide: Some community text mentions ten Pindians.
unadoptedConflictingLimits.decision: No numeric cap appears in the official current text. Neither ten nor twelve is implemented as an invented skill cap; availability follows actual cards, native Pindian and phase suppression.
